title: Tactical Containment Sandbox input grid for one region (or a sub-area)
description: Producer: P2 (land cover, elevation, slope) merged with P3's hex_fire_history. Consumers: P4, P6. One cell per H3 res-7 hex.

landcover_classes.description: ESA WorldCover class codes used in 'landcover'

landcover.description: ESA WorldCover majority class: 10 tree, 20 shrub, 30 grass, 40 crop, 50 built, 60 bare, 70 snow, 80 water, 90 wetland, 95 mangrove, 100 moss

burnable.description: landcover in {10, 20, 30, 40, 50}; water (80) is never burnable

slope_deg.description: Max slope to the 6 neighbor hexes: atan(max |dh| / center distance), degrees

burn_count.description: Harmonized fire cell-days in this hex over the whole record

years_since_last_fire.description: Years since last detection; null if never detected
